body.title: Recap: March 12th, 2026
body.description:
• Bitcoin is on the move after reclaiming the key $70,000 level, surging towards the $74,000 mark and fueling positive momentum into the broader market, with $HYPE continuing to hold its position as the top performer among high-cap coins over the past few days

• $TRUMP is on the move, surging +64% over the past 24 hours following news that top token holders may be invited to a Mar-a-Lago luncheon with Donald Trump

• $NEET maintains its position at center stage among Solana-based coins, becoming the most-held token on fomo. The token surged +50% over the past few days as it attempts a breakout after recent consolidation
